definitions.gloss: cooking method; way of cooking; recipe
definitions.explanation: A technique or approach for preparing food, encompassing specific procedures, heat application, and ingredient handling.

examples.japanese: {料理法|りょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look up a cooking method.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{料理法|りょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me how to cook this fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{料理法|りょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{全|まった}く→全く：02363_mattaku⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Even with the same ingredients, changing the cooking method produces a completely different flavor.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking; cuisine) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method; way). Used to refer to the specific technique or procedure for preparing a dish. Common in cookbooks, recipe sites, and cooking shows.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理法|りょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}する→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧: to devise a cooking method
- ⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な{料理法|りょうりほう}: traditional cooking method
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な{料理法|りょうりほう}: easy cooking method
- {料理法|りょうりほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}する→紹介する：05641_shoukaisuru⟧: to introduce a cooking method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{調理法|ちょうりほう}→調理法：20458_chourihou⟧: cooking method — more technical/professional term often used in food science or commercial kitchens
- ⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧: recipe — focuses on the specific step-by-step instructions and ingredient list
- ⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧: way of making — more casual, used in everyday conversation
